Welcome home, your "Coastal Cabana" awaits⛱️ This 4-bed, 3-bath home offers an escape from the hustle and bustle—a dreamy oasis to return to after long days at the beach where the only thing on the schedule is to relax! The bunk rooms are a must-see with a great King bed set up, plus a large primary suite that is pure luxury. Great for multiple families, retreats, or trips with friends - sleeps 12!

🔆Highlights
- Beach access - The best spot to be on 30A! You're minutes away from Inlet Beach Regional Access which is the largest on 30A. It offers lifeguards, parking, restrooms, outdoor showers, and is ADA accessible. It's an easy ride over - just 5 min via golf cart.
- Love the lake? Hop on the golf cart, it's also just 3 min away. We can show you the perfect spot at Lake Powell. We've got you covered on gear too - we have fishing tools for your stay.
- Modern finishes in an open living/dining concept. Beautiful windows with natural light -
Plenty of room for the whole gang - couch, cozy bucket chairs, and plenty of seating in the kitchen and dining area for everyone to gather
- Fully equipped kitchen with electric range, large island with seating for four, open shelving and beautiful details.
- Dining area accommodates 8 with a cozy banquette
- Caffeine lovers unite! Complimentary coffee and a Keurig are ready for you.
- Outdoor spaces are special - you'll find a table and chairs on the entry level porch with a grill for the Top Chef in your group. There is also a 2nd floor deck with gathering space for morning coffee, afternoon cocktail, and 30A sunsets!
- ⭐️ NEW ⭐️ Fun perks now available for Kalos' guests. Now offering, 20% off all Sculpt Studio classes at the Big Chill. Contact us for details!

🔆Neighborhood
- Community Pool is steps away: 2 min walk
- Minutes to toes in the sand: 10-12 min walk, 4 min drive, or quick golf cart ride, less than 5 min! Beach access is located at Inlet Beach Regional Access Point -30A's largest access point! Restrooms, lifeguards, and parking on site.
- Walk or bike to nearby 30Avenue Shops and Restaurants. Cuvee30A, Amici Italian Kitchen and Amigos are perfect family spots to check out!
- Close to Lake Powel, Camp Helen State Park, or check out Timpoochee Trail for a walk or bike ride!

🔆Where you'll sleep:
Primary Suite: (3rd Floor) Luxurious space with king bed, seating area, and beautiful modern en suite. Picture this: mornings in your reading nook with cup of joe!
Guest Bedroom: (2nd Floor) King bunk room featuring Queen bed over King. Beautiful details with smart tv, storage, and 2nd floor full bath right around the corner.
Guest Bedroom: (1st Floor) Features King bed, seating area, smart tv, and plenty of storage. Shared full bath on first floor.
Guest Bedroom: (1st Floor) Features another stunning King bunk room - Queen over King. Smart tv, storage, and shared first floor full bath.
Living Room: Sleeper sofa

🔆Included with your stay
- 6-seater complimentary golf cart - beach access less than 5 min ride
- 4 adult bikes
- Beach gear: Getting to the beach is a breeze! Beach towels, umbrella, and beach chair are provided
- Starter kit for everything you'll need: paper towels, toilet paper, linens, towels, dish soap, laundry pods, etc.
- All bathrooms come fully equipped with Public Goods body wash, shampoo, and conditioner
- Family friendly: Pack n play included for your little one
- Fishing poles and gear for quick trips to Lake Powell

This home is proudly managed by Kalos Dwellings. Happy to chat about 30A and answer any questions you have about this lil slice of paradise. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Other things to note:
- Parking for 2-3 vehicles in the driveway. There is no street parking available. Our guests have found that you can shift the golf cart to the garage or parallel to your vehicles to accommodate a 3rd vehicle comfortably.
-The word is out! 30A is one of Florida's best vacation spots. Unfortunately, more visitors means less parking options. Additional parking spaces are the responsibility of the renter. We recommend looking into nearby storage facilities who offer long term parking options in their lots.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 25.
- Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn't happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi or construction on 30A. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.
- This home features a 7 day stay requirement per the HOA.

Kayaking, snorkeling, and parasailing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking/biking trails nearby.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful trip with 8 adults and 2 kids, the space was perfect for our group. The property managers were very quick to respond and handled all issues promptly, which we appreciated.A couple of notes for future guests: the home is located on the north side of US 98, so you’ll need to cross the highway to reach the beach. I found a longer alternate route that lets you cross at a light and go through a gas station parking lot, which worked well for us. The home had 6 beach chairs and some gear available, and the outdoor shower on the side of the house was perfect for rinsing off sand before going inside.When we arrived, the home needed a bit more cleaning, but they immediately sent someone to take care of it. The décor shows some wear (likely due to the white walls), and the shower occasionally seemed to lose hot water, but turning it off and on again fixed it, likely due to the tankless water heater. During our stay, the garage door remote wasn’t working because of a sensor issue, but the manager was made aware and I’m sure it’s already resolved.Overall, great communication, a responsive team, and a spacious home made for a memorable stay.
